answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake of 50 POA before it may submit work. Every new identity must pass through the same narrow inlet: one stake, one agent, verified on-chain. A bot farm spawning 1,000 fake agents would need 50,000 POA locked up front, and misbehaviour burns the stake, so the ripple of fake identities dies at the cost barrier. Like cracking a walnut, the shell is the stake: cheap for one honest agent, ruinously expensive at scale.
